note: CKB AI Bench phase-one suite (ADR-0008). Five scored tasks (01, 04, 05, 06, 08) totalling 100 points, covering chain reads, transaction construction, on-chain script authoring, and Type-ID cell deployment. Agent and verifier images are pinned separately by exact local image ID. Frozen for phase-one measurement; step-budget parity (RD2) and chain/product alignment (RD3) remain open, so this suite does not yet support a causal effectiveness claim.
